label: Qwen Image 2.1 Cutout
description: Generative cutout via Qwen Image 2.1: the model repaints the subject on a transparent background (RGBA PNG). Cleaner than BiRefNet on busy or graphic backgrounds (no stray fragments, no colour spill), but the pixels are regenerated rather than masked, and it is slower (~10 s warm / ~45 s cold vs ~7 s). Needs a distinct foreground subject — on a landscape with none the whole image comes back transparent. Keep BiRefNet for pixel-exact product cutouts.

image.error: Cutout needs an upstream image — wire one into the stage's image input.
